customManagers.description: Track the workflows' annotated env pins, such as the Renovate validator's (ADR 011), here and in the template.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh this repo's uv.lock and the template's pnpm-lock.yaml weekly, merging once CI passes, so transitive fixes arrive without direct pins (ADR 008).

packageRules.description: Withhold TypeScript 7 until typescript-eslint and typedoc accept it as a peer; both still need the compiler API it dropped (ADR 009).
Bump the Renovate validator pin's minor and patch releases monthly, merging once CI passes, since Renovate releases several times a day; a major waits for review (ADR 011).
